items.title: Phil Woods interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: Harry was a regular member of the band... We just added the percussionist

ctx.x: And you had the extra fellas, a guitarist.

Well Harry was a regular member of the band, Harry was a regular member. We just added the percussionist because of the “Brazilian Suite.” A lot of people liked the idea that I sided “Cheek to Cheek” with the Ibert, the cadenza, showing how hip I am.
That’s a bear of a piece in itself.
